description: Ministry of Lands - Appointed Mr. K. W. A. G. Samarakkody and Mr. G. M. M. Puchibandara as Acquiring Officers under the Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka and Road Development Authority respectively and cancelled the appointment of Mrs. N. B. I. Nanayakkara publised in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1888/10 of 11.11.2014
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically concerns the appointment of officers (Mr. K. W. A. G. Samarakkody and Mr. G. M. M. Punchibandara) to function as Acquiring Officers for land acquisition duties related to development projects and road development projects. While it mentions government officials (Minister of Lands, Secretary), the core subject matter is land acquisition - a property/real estate matter that falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). The content does not focus on government structure/personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would warrant a government-related classification.
